activity_summary: At the end of Errors, Raye said the Wise Man is wizard's disguises and Welsh jokes and holds two thousand in its hand. You and John Heminges left the two thousand as a house. You did not ask to hear it again on Saturday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called two thousand a house and closed the subject.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Raye reported disguises, Welsh jokes, and a house of two thousand.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused a Rose sum and pointed him at the Jackdaw.
